text:
Ana - CSM: Heads-up — LyraFlow onboarding: their traffic pattern shows bursty short prompts (avg seq ~40) and a rising 95th %-ile latency. Thinking a proactive compact model + route split might shave cost and tame p95. Can we propose a low-risk plan? :thinking_face:

Sam - Eng: Do we have current metrics? p95, tokens/sec, and cost delta if we try a quantized variant?

Ana - CSM: Quick snapshot from their dashboard this morning: p95 ~ 420ms, median ~85ms, avg tokens/request ~38, 120 req/s peak. Cost today ~$2.1k/mo on hosted tier. They’re on a renewal in 6 weeks — want to show wins.

Priya - SuccessOps: +1 on proactive. Suggest a canary: 5% of traffic to int8 compact model with routing fallback to baseline on error/latency >600ms. Also do a small prefix cache for common prompts.

Miguel - ML Eng: I can produce a quant profile and perf estimate. Based on similar workloads, int8 compact reduces per-token GPU time ~27–32% and p95 often drops 10–15% due to shorter scheduling. Risks: slight quality delta on few prompt types. Recommend run against their canonical prompt set.

Jordan - PM: Capture acceptance criteria for customer: p95 improvement >=10% OR cost decrease >=15% without >1% decrease in macro-quality metrics. If either satisfied, offer it as part of renewal bundle.

Ana - CSM: Good. Miguel, can you paste the suggested canary routing + quant config we should push to the console? I’ll coordinate with LyraFlow for opt-in hours.

Miguel - ML Eng: Sure — minimal config snippet we use for these pilots:

```
route_policy:
  - name: lyraflow-quant-canary
    match: "user.client == 'lyraflow' && rand() < 0.05"
    target_model: gpt-compact-int8-v1
    fallback: gpt-compact-fp16-v1
    latency_slo_ms: 600
    metrics: [p95, error_rate, perplexity_delta]
quant_profile: int8-aggressive
prefix_cache: enabled
cache_keys: [prefix_hash]
watch_prompts: ["signup flow", "billing question", "error summary"]
```

Miguel - ML Eng: Also will run a quick eval harness: sample 500 canonical prompts -> measure ppl delta and qualitative diffs. I’ll post results in here by EOD tomorrow.

Priya - SuccessOps: I'll add an enablement doc for LyraFlow with rollback steps and a short FAQ for their SREs. Also scheduling: propose Wed 09:00 PDT for initial 5% canary.

Ana - CSM: I’ll ping LyraFlow now. @Jordan — can you draft the renewal note that includes this pilot as a value highlight?

Jordan - PM: On it, will drop a draft by EOD.

deploy-bot: deployment queued for canary route 'lyraflow-quant-canary' (dry-run). Logs: /deploys/2123456789/preview

Sam - Eng: If Miguel’s eval looks clean, we should also add a dynamic split that increases canary to 20% during off-peak hours for faster signal. Add check: error_rate < 0.5% and p95 < 600ms before ramp.

Ana - CSM: Thanks team. Action items: Miguel -> eval + perf numbers; Priya -> enablement doc + rollback; Jordan -> renewal draft; Ana -> customer coordination + confirm Wed 09:00; Sam -> prepare dynamic ramp policy. Will update thread when LyraFlow confirms. :thumbsup:
